name: Septinsular Republic (1800–1807)
description: A blue field bearing the golden winged lion of St Mark holding a gospel book and a sheaf of seven arrows.
history: Flag of the Septinsular Republic, the Russo-Ottoman-sponsored state of the seven Ionian islands (1800–1807) — the first self-governing Greek polity of the modern era.

features.role: winged lion of St Mark with seven arrows
features.symbolism: the Venetian lion retained; the seven arrows are the seven Ionian islands
